scope: Proposition 2.1 (Weights for adjacent intervals) of the manuscript “Positive lower density of large prime gaps” (preprints/Positive-lower-density-of-large-prime-gaps-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 026 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7a4a37fa92b30f4e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each fixed λ > 0 there is a finite constant Kλ > 0 with the following property. For every ε > 0, there are weights WX(m) ≥ 0, defined for integers X < m ≤ 2X, such that EXWX −→ 1, EX(WXVJ ) −→ λ, (1) lim sup X→∞ EX(WXVI) ≤ ε, lim sup X→∞ EX(WXV 2 J ) ≤ Kλ, (2) EXW2 X = Oλ,ε(1). (3) The constant Kλ is independent of ε.
